newsitem.title: POLAND: NBP SELLS PLN 400 MLN OF NBP-BILLS.
newsitem.headline: NBP SELLS PLN 400 MLN OF NBP-BILLS.

text.p: The National Bank of Poland sold 100 million zlotys, the amount on offer of 91-day NBP-bills and the entire 300 million offer of 182-day bills, the bank said.
The bank sold the 91-day bills at an average rate of 21.91 percent, up from 21.85 percent at the last auction on December 30, 1996.
It sold the 182-day paper at an average rate of 21.97 percent, 0.02 point up from the last auction on December 31, 1996
